description: This file contains benchmarking code for various matrix multiplication backends (including CUTLASS, Triton, and ATEN) in PyTorch, with classes and functions for configuring experiments, running benchmarks, and processing results.

classes.name: ExperimentConfig
classes.description: Abstract base class for experiment configurations with common parameters and methods.

classes.name: CutlassExperimentConfig
classes.description: Configuration for CUTLASS backend experiments, including instantiation level.

classes.name: TritonExperimentConfig
classes.description: Configuration for Triton backend experiments, including persistent TMA option.

classes.name: ExperimentGroupConfig
classes.description: Configuration for a group of experiments with specific operation, shape, dtype, and batch size.

classes.name: ExperimentResults
classes.description: Stores results of a single experiment run, including timing and performance metrics.

classes.name: ExperimentGroup
classes.description: Contains a configuration and associated results for a set of experiments.

methods.name: benchmark_torch_function_in_microseconds
methods.description: Runs a torch function multiple times to measure execution time in microseconds.

methods.name: get_inputs
methods.description: Generates input tensors based on experiment group configuration.

methods.name: run_single_experiment_group
methods.description: Runs all experiments in a group and collects results.

methods.name: generate_experiment_groups
methods.description: Creates multiple experiment group configurations based on parameter combinations.

methods.name: generate_experiment_configs
methods.description: Creates different experiment configurations for each backend and level.

methods.name: calculate_table_data
methods.description: Processes experiment results into tabular data for display.

methods.name: calculate_flops
methods.description: Calculates the number of floating point operations for a given operation and shape.

methods.name: get_printable_results
methods.description: Formats experiment results into a human-readable table with performance metrics.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to run all experiments, collect, and display results.
